Congress Leader Predicts Party's Return to Power

Karnataka Congress President DK Shivakumar has expressed confidence that the party will retain power in the state in 2028 and form the government at the Centre in 2029. He stated that an FIR against Rahul Gandhi cannot silence him. Shivakumar's remarks were made in the context of ongoing political discussions and legal challenges.
